title: Pig in Mud
pages: The pig is in the mud.
The pig can dig and dig.
The pig is big and hot.
The pig had fun in the mud.
Yum! The pig is a mud pig.

title: Hen and Eggs
pages: A hen sat on ten eggs.
The hen sat in the shed.
The hen did not get up.
The eggs go tap, tap, tap.
Pop! A chick did pop up.
Ten chicks run to the hen.
